title: Valentine's Date Night

title: The Food Thief
concept: Dante caught mid-steal — mouth around something he shouldn't have, giving the camera his most innocent 'what? I didn't do anything' look. His food thief persona is the hook. Pure comedy moment that's relatable to every dog owner.
visual_direction: Kitchen counter setting, natural daylight streaming in. Close-up of Dante's face with something in his mouth, wide guilty eyes with one eyebrow raised, brown teddy bear fluff framing his expressive face. Single frozen moment of being caught red-handed. Vertical 9:16.
caption_direction: Comedy/relatable tone. Dante's sophisticated-but-silly voice: 'I didn't steal it. I relocated it to my mouth.' CTA: what does your dog steal? Hashtags: #funnydog #funnypet #dogsoftiktok #poodle #guilty #doglover #cutedog
instagram_caption:
He didn't steal it. He simply relocated it to his mouth.
